body_markdown:
## AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) — Q2 2026 Earnings Preview


### Key Points


Factor Details & What to Watch


**Q2 2026 Revenue Guidance** $11.2B ± $300M; consensus at $11,285M (+46% YoY, +9% QoQ)


**Q2 2026 Gross Margin Guide** Non-GAAP ~56%; consensus at 55.8%


**Data Center Segment** Q1 2026: $5.8B (+57% YoY); Q2: double-digit sequential growth guided; server CPU revenue guided +70% YoY


**Client & Gaming Segment** Q1 2026: $3.6B (+23% YoY); Q2: modest sequential growth guided


**Embedded Segment** Q1 2026: $873M (+6% YoY); Q2: double-digit sequential growth guided


**AI/Agentic AI Impact** Agentic AI driving incremental CPU demand; Data Center now primary growth driver


**Supply Chain/Memory Costs** Tight supply for wafers and memory; higher component costs impacting PC/Gaming in H2
